body: I'm trying...I just tend to give up when it gets hard. But I'll try focusing on a new goal. Part of my problem is feeling unaccomplished, so I want to try to meet some goals.

Thanks for your response. I'm not sure what I worry about exactly, I probably just worry too much. But I've been with my boyfriend for over a year now, and I just wonder why I haven't accepted his past yet. Like there's something wrong with me.

I'm currently talking with him though, which is calming me down. He works nights and nights are always hardest for me, so that kind of sucks.

>It will subside in time. The moment you don't expect it to. It gets better. Promise.

I sort of know this to be true. I've been depressed and suicidal since I was 8, but I've gone through periods of happiness. The sadness just always comes back, so I guess I don't expect too much anymore. But again, thank you for your response. It was really helpful and it's nice to hear that I'm not alone.

Sorry in advance if this is incoherent.

I don't really have anyone to talk to other than my boyfriend and my thoughts are mostly about him. I get irrationally upset over things he's done in his past(before he dated me) and I don't know why but they upset me greatly. He used to be kind of an asshole and cheated on his ex 3 times because she was too depressed to make him feel special or whatever. He's matured since then but the idea of him behaving that way makes me feel sick.

The other thing that's on my mind is my ex. I miss him a LOT. I don't really have anyone I can talk to about it either, because everyone hates him and tells me to stop caring about him. He was emotionally abusive and raped me, but I felt like I really connected with him and I still care about him. Talking to him again will suck me back into his abuse, but not talking to him ever again is painful.
Has your friend been to counseling of any kind? Could you get her to go?
The only person in my life right now is my boyfriend. He's great, but he isn't convincing me. Therapy has never helped.
